scripts.typecheck: wrangler types worker/worker-configuration.d.ts >/dev/null && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p worker
scripts.deploy: node scripts/require-env.mjs NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY NEXT_PUBLIC_GOATCOUNTER_URL && next build && node scripts/check-build.mjs out e2e/e2e.env && wrangler secret list | node scripts/check-secrets.mjs TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY CONTACT_TO SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL STATS_PASSWORD && wrangler d1 migrations apply naidenko-stats --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/with-env.mjs e2e/e2e.env next build && playwright test
